Maybe we're not providing her

that for the first six months of her life,

and-and-and breasts and womb, lady bits-

We're being ridiculous.

Mommy.

segments.sceneTitle: 是否安全
segments.text: - Hey, Dad. - Hmm?
segments.translation: -爸爸 -什么事

segments.sceneTitle: 是否安全
segments.text: Mom says there's an old trunk in the attic.
segments.translation: 妈妈说阁楼里有个旧行李箱

segments.sceneTitle: 是否安全
segments.text: Oh, yeah. My grandpa's old steamer trunk.
segments.translation: 是的 我爷爷的旧扁平行李箱

segments.sceneTitle: 是否安全
segments.text: In this movie I saw, there was this old trunk...
segments.translation: 我看的一个电影 里面有一个行李箱

segments.sceneTitle: 是否安全
segments.text: and there's a secret compartment.
segments.translation: 和一间秘室

segments.sceneTitle: 是否安全
segments.text: And when you opened it, there was a whole bunch of paintings,
segments.translation: 打开以后 里面有很多幅画

segments.sceneTitle: 是否安全
segments.text: by the world's greatest painters, hidden in the war.
segments.translation: 都是战争时期藏起来的大画家的作品

segments.sceneTitle: 是否安全
segments.text: My grandpa was in the war.
segments.translation: 我爷爷参与过战争

segments.sceneTitle: 是否安全
segments.text: Should we go up there?
segments.translation: 我们要上去看一看吗

segments.sceneTitle: 是否安全
segments.text: Totally. It could also be diamonds.
segments.translation: 绝对的 说不定里面是钻石呢

segments.sceneTitle: 是否安全
segments.text: Or a samurai sword.
segments.translation: 或者是日本武士军刀

segments.sceneTitle: 是否安全
segments.text: Or the Declaration of Independence.
segments.translation: 或者是《独立宣言》

segments.sceneTitle: 是否安全
segments.text: You know, it almost doesn't even matter what's up there.
segments.translation: 阁楼里有什么并不重要

segments.sceneTitle: 是否安全
segments.text: What matters is what you do with the money from what's up there.
segments.translation: 重要的是怎么花用它换来的钱

segments.sceneTitle: 是否安全
segments.text: We could get a motorboat.
segments.translation: 我们可以买艘汽艇

segments.sceneTitle: 是否安全
segments.text: Or a robotic gutter cleaner.
segments.translation: 或者下水道清理机器人

segments.sceneTitle: 是否安全
segments.text: - Or an indoor pool. - Or a two-man submarine.
segments.translation: -或者室内泳池 -或者双人潜水艇
